overview.description: The Defiance US 100 Tech AI Moat ETF (AIX) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Indxx US 100 Tech AI Moat index. The fund tracks a market cap-weighted index of 30 Nasdaq-listed companies identified as having AI moats, based on factors including AI exposure, R&D intensity, and evidence of AI development and investment. The fund excludes those with at least 50% of revenue from AI-vulnerable technology categories. AIX was launched on Jun 24, 2026 and is issued by Defiance.
